# Demand Research (AI-generated by Vance / Grok Bot, Oct 16, 2026)

## Verdict
Top pick: **AI Receptionist Finder**, a neutral directory comparing AI phone receptionists by trade (plumbers, HVAC, dental, salons, law, restaurants), with verified prices and a cost-per-month calculator. It beats the others because it is the only candidate with all four: steady rising demand (Google Trends US 12 mo avg 30.1 to 34.0; 5 yr from 0 to 20), a long autocomplete tail of trade-specific queries, results dominated by biased vendor blogs, and buyers (vendors) with large budgets for sponsorships and recurring affiliates. Nick chooses.

## Method and limits
- Google autocomplete (suggestqueries.google.com, client=firefox), 22 seed queries, raw output in ac.txt.
- Google Trends via pytrends, US, raw output in trends.txt and trends2.txt. Values are relative (0 to 100 within each comparison), not volumes.
- X recent post counts (x MCP, 7 days, no retweets).
- Web search of current top results for competition.
- Not reachable or not used: Reddit JSON returned non-JSON (blocked from box). Free keyword tools (keywordtool.io, Ubersuggest, Ahrefs) not run, so **no absolute search volumes**. People Also Ask and Product Hunt not checked. Treat demand as directional.

# UPDATE Oct 16, 2026: absolute volumes, affiliates, go/no-go (AI-generated by Vance)

## Verdict: GO, with a narrower angle
Build AI Receptionist Finder, positioned as a neutral **"answering service vs AI receptionist" cost comparison by trade**, not a generic AI receptionist list. Volumes are real (tens of thousands a month, triple year over year), clicks are very valuable (CPC $34 to $405), and 4+ vendors pay 15% to 30% recurring. Risk: at least two direct directories already exist (aifrontdesklist.com, theaiagentreport.com), so the edge must be the cost calculator, checked prices, and the "answering service" keywords that most owners actually type.

## How volumes were obtained
Free tools (Ahrefs keyword generator, WordStream) load data by JavaScript behind a captcha, so curl returned no numbers; I did not bypass that. Keyword tool, Ubersuggest and Keyword Planner need login. Numbers below come from public pages that publish Google Ads based estimates. They disagree with each other, so treat as ranges.

## Go conditions
1. Launch on "answering service for [trade]" and "AI vs answering service cost" pages, with a calculator using checked prices.
2. Sign up for Frontdesk, Rosie, ViFi and Retell affiliate programs (Nick must approve; needs his identity and tax form).
3. Sell sponsor slots to vendors via Stripe link; high CPCs justify $200 to $500/week.
4. Kill test: if under 1,000 organic visits/mo after 90 days, stop.
